result.problems: Resume only: no new computation was needed. Standing caveats carried in FINDINGS section 8 / findings.json.caveats: (1) 1-minute nulls rest on 8 one-year tapes per generator so their percentiles are wide; the 5-minute nulls are the primary certificate. (2) GMM-Markov under-produces kurtosis and |r| autocorrelation (a narrower-than-reality null), which is why the pass rule requires the segment bootstrap too. (3) Tape price levels random-walk over 1,026 sessions, so INR diffs on high-level tapes widen the null (conservative p95). (4) `sl` (raw stop price, |rho| 0.93 with time) and `n_events_asof` (cumulative count, rho 1.0) are in Table.asof_columns() but are time proxies; reported for the harness allow-list (NOT_FEATURES), not changed here per scope. (5) Drift inside IS is strong on both timeframes (AUC B 0.947 / 0.973 vs permutation p95 ~0.525) and led by the volatility/price-level regime, so point-denominated thresholds are level rules; gate studies should use _atr/_bps forms and CPCV path distributions.
